Hikvision Cat 6 Ethernet Cable – Orange 

The Hikvision Cat 6 UTP Ethernet Cable (Orange) is a high-performance copper network cable engineered for reliable and efficient data transmission. Ideal for surveillance systems, office networks, and high-speed internet connections, this cable delivers stable gigabit Ethernet performance and supports Power over Ethernet (PoE). The bright orange PVC sheath allows for easy cable identification and management in structured cabling installations.


Key Features:

  • Category: Cat 6 UTP (Unshielded Twisted Pair)
  • Conductor Material: Solid bare copper (99.95% purity)
  • Conductor Diameter: 0.55 ± 0.005 mm (23 AWG)
  • Insulation: High-Density Polyethylene (HDPE)
  • Insulation Diameter: 0.98 ± 0.05 mm
  • Sheath Material: PVC (Polyvinyl Chloride)
  • Outer Diameter: 6.00 ± 0.30 mm
  • Sheath Thickness: 0.50 ± 0.10 mm
  • Sheath Color: Orange
  • Rip Cord: Yes
  • Central Separator: Yes (enhances crosstalk resistance)
  • Operating Voltage: 60V
  • Temperature Range: -20°C to +75°C
  • Flame Retardant: No (non-fire-resistant version)
  • Compliance Standards: ANSI/TIA-568-C.2, ISO/IEC 11801, RoHS 2.0
  • Electrical Performance:
  • Bandwidth: Up to 250 MHz
  • Data Transmission Speed: Up to 1 Gbps
  • Impedance: 100 ± 15 ohms (≤100 MHz), 100 ± 25 ohms (100–250 MHz)
  • DC Resistance: ≤ 9.38 ohms per 100 meters
  • DC Resistance Unbalance: ≤ 5.0%
  • Delay Skew: ≤ 45 ns per 100 meters


Applications:

IP CCTV systems

PoE (Power over Ethernet) devices

Routers, switches, patch panels

Data centers and enterprise networks

Home or office structured cabling
